meta.label: Image Cleaner
meta.description: Detect, scan, and optionally delete stale Dataiku container images from the target host's container registry. Runs on the target DSS host so cloud metadata and registry credentials are local to that host.

params.name: provider
params.label: Provider
params.description: Registry provider: ecr, acr, or gar. ECR is currently implemented for remote macro operations.

params.name: cutoff
params.label: Cutoff date
params.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Images pushed before this date are considered deletable.

params.name: images_json
params.label: Images JSON
params.description: JSON array of {repositoryName, imageDigest} entries for delete.

params.name: dryRun
params.label: Dry run
params.description: When true, validate delete candidates without deleting.
